parsed.summary: The PR addresses a specific issue but introduces a change that may have unintended consequences.

issues.description: The change to enforce `dtype=[np.float64, np.float32]` may break existing behavior for users who rely on boolean inputs being implicitly converted to float.
The PR does not include any new tests to verify that boolean inputs are correctly handled. This increases the risk of regressions in the future.
